content.title: What time is 'American Idol' on tonight? How to watch 2026 Top 14
content.text: April 6, 2026, 12:01 p.m. MTThere are 14 contestants remaining on Season 24 as "American Idol" turns its attention from “Songs of Faith” to "’90s Judges' Song Contest," which as the title clearly indicates, means those 14 hopefuls will be singing ’90s songs selected by Luke Bryan, Carrie Underwood and Lionel Richie.The “Songs of Faith” episode started by weeding the Top 20 down to the 14 singers who performed on last week’s episode, with Brooks boldly choosing John Lennon’s “Imagine,” which famously opens on the line “Imagine there's no heaven/ It's easy if you try / No hell below us/ Above us, only sky.”We’ll see the how the Christians Nationalists tuning in for “Songs of Faith” respond to that.Two contestants were supposed to be sent home at the conclusion of the episode, but the voting turnout was much higher than expected, so we’ll find out when the show returns on Monday, April 6.Here’s everything you need to know about the latest episode of “American Idol.”'American Idol' vote 2026You can’t use the “American Idol” app in 2026. That’s been discontinued. You can still vote through the website, though, at americanidol.com, or via text.Top 14 'American Idol' contestants for 2026These are the singers remaining in the "American Idol" Top 14 for 2026:Jordan McCulloughBrooksKyndal InskeepPhilmon LeeBraden RumfeltJake ThistleJesse FindlingLucas LeonHannah HarperChris TungsethJulián KalelRaeDaniel StallworthKeyla RichardsonFan favorite Hannah Harper sang 'Ain't No Grave' in HawaiiHannah Harper sang “At the Cross (Love Ran Red)" by worship leader Chris Tomlin, telling Ryan Seacrest the song was an “opportunity to give an invitation” to Jesus.What did 'American Idol' contestants sing on 'Songs of Faith' night?Here's who sang what:Jake Thistle did "Have a Little Faith in Me" by John Hiatt.Daniel Stallworth did "Brighter Days" by Blessing Offor.Kyndal Inskeep did "Nothing But the Blood of Jesus" by Robert Lowry.Jesse Findling did "Bless the Broken Road" by the Nitty Gritty Dirt Band.Hannah Harper did “At the Cross (Love Ran Red)" by Chris Tomlin.Braden Rumfelt did "Hard Fought Hallelujah" by Brandon Lake.Brooks did "Imagine" by John Lennon.Philmon Lee did "Simple Man" by Lynyrd Skynyrd.Rae did "Up to the Mountain (MLK Song)" by Patty Griffin.Lucas Leon did "Gratitude" by Brandon Lake.Jordan McCullough did "I Can Only Imagine" by MercyMe.Chris Tungseth did "By Your Grace" by Cody Johnson.Julian Kalel did "Fix You" by Coldplay.Keyla Richardson did "Jireh" by Elevation Worship and Maverick City Music.This newsletter goes to 11. Sign up for weekly music news. Where are 'American Idol' contestants competing tonight?"American Idol" is in Los Angeles this week.2026 judges for 'American Idol'The judges for Season 24 of "American Idol" are Lionel Richie, Luke Bryan and Carrie Underwood, who joined the cast in 2025 when Katy Perry signed off after seven seasons.Before signing on as a judge, Underwood won Season 4 and went on to enjoy one of the most successful post-“Idol” careers of any former winner — right up there with Kelly Clarkson.Is 'American Idol' on tonight?Yes. "American Idol" will feature the Top 20 hopefuls competing live in Los Angeles on Monday, April 6.When is 'American Idol' on tonight?"American Idol" airs at 8 p.m. ET and 7 p.m. Arizona time.How to watch 'American Idol' tonightYou can watch "American Idol" live on ABC15 in Arizona or on your local ABC network.'American Idol' time"American Idol" airs at 8 p.m. ET and 7 p.m. Arizona time.What is 'American Idol' on tonight?In addition to airing in Arizona on ABC15, "American Idol" Season 24 will be available to stream the following day on Hulu.A subscription to Hulu costs $11.99 a month (or $119.99/year) for the ad-supported plan. Students can get Hulu with ads for $1.99 a month, and Hulu Premium, with no ads, is $18.99 a month.'American Idol' winnersTrying to remember who won "American Idol" the year you graduated high school or more recently?
